title: Add Why Choose Us, Privacy Policy, and Terms & Conditions to mobile hamburger menu

requirements.text: In the mobile hamburger menu (defined in frontend/src/App.tsx), add a 'Why Choose Us' link navigating to /why-choose-us, positioned after 'About Us' and before 'Products'. The link must close the mobile menu when tapped and use the translation key nav.whyChooseUs.

quotes: Add a Why Choose Us link in the mobile menu, positioned after About Us and before Products, navigating to /why-choose-us

acceptanceCriteria: A 'Why Choose Us' link appears in the mobile hamburger menu after 'About Us' and before 'Products'
Tapping the link closes the mobile menu
The link text is driven by the nav.whyChooseUs translation key

requirements.text: In the mobile hamburger menu, add a 'Privacy Policy' link navigating to /privacy-policy, positioned immediately before 'Contact Us'. The link must close the mobile menu when tapped and use the translation key nav.privacyPolicy.

quotes: Add a Privacy Policy link in the mobile menu, positioned immediately before Contact Us, navigating to /privacy-policy

acceptanceCriteria: A 'Privacy Policy' link appears in the mobile hamburger menu immediately before 'Contact Us'
Tapping the link closes the mobile menu
The link text is driven by the nav.privacyPolicy translation key

requirements.text: In the mobile hamburger menu, add a 'Terms & Conditions' link navigating to /terms-and-conditions, positioned after 'Privacy Policy' and before 'Contact Us'. The link must close the mobile menu when tapped and use the translation key nav.termsConditions.

quotes: Add a Terms & Conditions link in the mobile menu, positioned after Privacy Policy and before Contact Us, navigating to /terms-and-conditions

acceptanceCriteria: A 'Terms & Conditions' link appears in the mobile hamburger menu after 'Privacy Policy' and before 'Contact Us'
Tapping the link closes the mobile menu
The link text is driven by the nav.termsConditions translation key

requirements.text: Add translation keys nav.whyChooseUs, nav.privacyPolicy, and nav.termsConditions to frontend/src/translations/translations.ts for all three supported languages: English (en), Hindi (hi), and Marathi (mr). English values: 'Why Choose Us', 'Privacy Policy', 'Terms & Conditions'. Provide appropriate Hindi and Marathi translations.

quotes: Add translation keys nav.whyChooseUs, nav.privacyPolicy, and nav.termsConditions in English, Hindi, and Marathi to translations.ts

acceptanceCriteria: nav.whyChooseUs, nav.privacyPolicy, and nav.termsConditions keys exist in the en, hi, and mr translation maps
All three keys return non-empty appropriate strings for each language
No existing translation keys are removed or altered

constraints: Changes are scoped to the mobile hamburger menu only; do not modify the desktop navigation bar
Do not alter existing mobile menu links or their routes
All new links must reuse the same close-menu handler pattern used by existing mobile menu items
nonGoals: Adding these links to the desktop navigation bar
Adding these links to the Footer
Creating or modifying WhyChooseUsPage, PrivacyPolicyPage, or TermsAndConditionsPage components
